subject: Pilot kickoff confirmation — AcumenRx scope, evals, and access
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Feldman <anna@acumenrx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot scope (what we covered)

Anna / Carlos — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps to start a short pilot: 

Pain points you shared
- Clinical review latency: model-assisted triage is taking 30–45s per document and blocking throughput.
- High inference cost on current setup (spiky throughput during claims intake).
- Auditability: need token-level logs and prompt-set versioning for compliance.

Pilot goals (success metrics)
- Reduce average per-document latency from ~40s to <10s (90th percentile target: <15s).
- Achieve >= 95% precision on entity extraction for the 6 diagnostic fields in the prompt set.
- Demonstrate 30% per-token cost reduction using batching + KV caching on Redwood.

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks)
1) Data: 2k de-identified documents (sample provided by AcumenRx)
2) Models/evals: run 3 eval variants (base open model, quantized variant, and a cached-batching profile) against the same prompt set and acceptance test.
3) Owners: Redwood SE (Ben) for infra/config; AcumenRx ML (Carlos) for labels & evaluation; Sofia for kickoff and milestone coordination.
4) Access: S3 read-only sample + short SLA for access; optional on-prem package discussion if PHI concerns surface.
5) Deliverables: weekly status notes, final eval report, and runbook for production rollout.

Immediate asks from our side
- Anna: confirm data sample timeline (we discussed EOD next Tuesday) and any additional compliance constraints (HIPAA, BAA routing).
- AcumenRx procurement: if you want Redwood to sign an NDA/BAA ahead of data sharing, please route to procure@acumenrx.com.

Proposed next steps
- I’ll get Ben to draft the technical access checklist and sample upload instructions by EOD tomorrow.
- Anna to share the data sample and the primary contact for procurement.
- Schedule kickoff: Wed 11/10 at 10am PT — please confirm.

Thanks — happy to adjust scope if you'd prefer a shorter spike.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwoodinference.com
redwoodinference.com
From: Anna Feldman <anna@acumenrx.com>

Date: 2026-11-03T17:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot scope (what we covered)

Thanks Sofia — this is super helpful and matches our notes. A few clarifications/questions from our side: 

- Data sample: we can deliver ~2k documents but need to run them through our de-ident pipeline first. ETA: Nov 6 COB.
- Compliance: we require a BAA before any dataset with potential PHI is shared. Are you able to share a standard BAA or sign ours?
- Evaluation metrics: precision on entity extraction is critical; we also want to see recall for a subset of 500 labeled docs. Can Redwood run both precision & recall reports?

On timeline: the proposed kickoff window works but could we shift the formal start to week of Nov 15 to accommodate legal & data prep? We still want the 4-week scope once started.

Also copying procurement (procure@acumenrx.com) to route SOW questions.

Anna Feldman
Head of Data Products, AcumenRx
anna@acumenrx.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Feldman <anna@acumenrx.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-11-04T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot scope (what we covered)

Quick technical notes from SE perspective:

- We'll prepare three eval variants as Sofia outlined. For recall checks on the 500 labeled docs, please provide a gold-label CSV with stable IDs.
- Access options: S3 read-only or a short-term secure file transfer. For S3, we need an IAM role ARN (preferred) or time-limited credentials with a bucket path and prefix.
- Redaction: if you want Redwood to perform additional redaction we can enable a pre-processing step, but it changes cost/time estimates — I’ll include both baseline and redaction-adjusted timelines in the access checklist.
- If AcumenRx cannot share de-id data, we can demo the flow with synthetic data + a small labeled slice on your side via Redwood Private (VPC) — happy to discuss.

I’ll attach the access checklist and ingest playbook in the next message (short attachment).

—Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Procurement: Sofia will coordinate on our side with legal; Kimberley (CC) will assist with procurement/contract onboarding.

- Kickoff timing: provisional start week of Nov 15; planning meeting scheduled for Mon Nov 15, 10am PT (calendar invite to follow).

Owners & milestones
- Sofia (AE): overall coordination, weekly syncs, exec updates.
- Ben (SE): technical integration, access, evals, and final runbook.
- Carlos (AcumenRx): labels & evaluation triage; Anna: procurement & product signoff.

Immediate deliverables

- Sofia: mutual action plan doc (shared link) and kickoff calendar invite.
- AcumenRx: BAA or legal contact + confirmation of SOW items to finalize procurement.
